hero.title: Plant Essential Oil Bracelet that keeps mosquitoes away naturally
hero.description: A flexible silica gel band with a triple-layer botanical core that releases a gentle aroma halo for up to 90 days. No DEET, no heavy sprays—just slip it on and head outside.

craftsmanship.title: Engineered for comfort, crafted for natural defense
craftsmanship.description: Every bracelet blends clean materials with thoughtful hardware: a breathable silica gel wrap, golden detail caps, and a memory metal spine that flexes to hug your wrist.

specs.title: Built to travel with you
specs.description: A featherweight profile slots into any travel pouch. The outer shell wipes clean, while the inner cores can be refreshed with new botanical sticks for another 90-day cycle.

values.product_name: Qualitell Plant Essential Oil Bracelet Q1

lifestyle.title: Memory metal bracelet can be easily adjusted in size
lifestyle.description: Made with memory steel wire, automatically adjusts size to fit wrist. No clasps, no pinching—just slip it on and it molds to your shape.

features.one_size: One size fits all wrists comfortably
features.stackable: Wear stacked with other bracelets or solo

highlights.title: Three layers of protection, one simple bracelet

pure_plant.title: Pure plant extract without DEET
pure_plant.description: Extracted from natural plants such as citronella oil, eucalyptus oil, and lemon oil, the brand new scientific formula is safe and healthy for repelling mosquitoes.

360_repellent.title: 360° full-body mosquito repellent
360_repellent.description: Purifies human body odor, releases odors that mosquitoes dislike, and resists mosquito harassment.

waterproof.title: Completely waterproof and sweatproof
waterproof.description: Uses a core that is not soluble in water, providing completely waterproof and sweatproof protection.

comparison.title: Long-lasting and stable volatilization
comparison.description: Our repellent stick core delivers Grade A mosquito repellent factor for up to 90 days, while patches fade after a day and disposable rings last only hours.

repellent_stick.label: Repellent stick core
repellent_stick.others: Long-lasting and stable volatilization (Grade A mosquito repellent factor)

cta.title: 90-Day Long-Lasting Mosquito Repellent
cta.description: Upgraded with 3 layers of mosquito repellent cores, including a 3-layer inner core for enhanced effectiveness. Provides up to 90 days of mosquito repellent protection when used.
